"""Good: only the password FORM is produced (LINT-07)."""


def run(self, entity, ctx):
    res = self.result(entity)
    entry = ctx.http.get_json("https://api.example.com/v1/leaks/" + entity.value)
    form = "plaintext" if entry.get("password") else "unknown"
    res.attr("password_form", form)
    res.attr("breaches", [b["name"] for b in entry.get("breaches", [])])
    return res
